gameplayNotes: Faces [ ] During Phase 1, Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad will exclusively use his "Formation" face, described on this page. During Phase 2, Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad will alternate between his "Formation" and "Existence faces after he takes action. Contrary to the description, Asat Pramad will not use Meme Setup or Meme Carnival when using his "Existence" face, and will not use Gambit of Converging Fates while using his "Formation" face. When Phase 3 starts, Asat Pramad’s faces (listed from left to right) have the following initial action advances: "Existence" : 50% "Decay" : 100% "Formation" : 0% During Phase 3, "Formation" acts at a base SPD of 140 , while "Existence" acts at a base SPD of 120 . "Formation" [ ] While an ally has Meme'd , their Ultimate is replaced with a special action that prematurely detonates 1 of their stacks. However, their Ultimates can still be charged normally during this period. The 4 stacks of Meme'd generated by Meme Setup will be evenly distributed between all targetable ally characters. If there are 3 targets on the field, only one character will receive 2 stacks. Meme'd is automatically dispelled if Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad is Weakness Broken or changes phase. Other [ ] "Take the Stage" acts at a Base SPD of 115 , and its first action is advanced by 100% . It takes immediate action when Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad changes phase. "The Game is On" acts at a Base SPD of 95 . Its SPD is increased by 35% in Phase 3. When entering Phase 2, Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad: "Existence" will immediately use Gambit of Converging Fates , before switching faces. During Phase 3, the total Max HP of all 3 faces is 165% of the original. [ verification needed ]

gameplayNotes: Lordly Trashcans are listed along with Treasures and Warp Trotters in map exploration progress. To obtain the reward for a Lordly Trashcan, the player must interact with the idle Trashcan and respond to its questions. If the player answers the questions correctly, the rewards will be given directly without having to enter battle. If the player answers incorrectly, the Lordly Trashcan will attempt to ambush the player. It is possible to dodge a Lordly Trashcan's ambush attempt, though it is not possible to engage in battle without being ambushed. Attempting to attack a Lordly Trashcan will only stun it briefly, without entering battle. If the player dodges the Lordly Trashcan's attack and leaves its detection radius, the Lordly Trashcan will return to its idle state and will become interactable again. This allows the player to restart the dialogue from the beginning. When fighting a Lordly Trashcan, the player must either cause a Weakness Break or deplete its health like a normal enemy. The latter option is nearly impossible outside of Divergent/Simulated Universe, since this would require three combat types to avoid accidentally breaking its Toughness bar, and it would likely have enough ATK to instantly defeat anyone it attacks. Once their Toughness depletes, Lordly Trashcans will immediately enter a follow-up action, bowing and leaving the battle.

gameplayNotes: From Apocalyptic Shadow: Idol of the Locusts onwards, the Toughness of Sky-Shrouding Stardevourer Swarm is increased from 200 x3 to 240 x3 in Stage 4. Gnaw Stings summoned by this boss have Weaknesses. The Gnaw Sting summoned by Radiating Venom will immediately take action. Growth Hormones can stack up to 3 times. When a Gnaw Sting reaches 3 stacks of Growth Hormones, its attacks have a chance to inflict the Entanglement effect on the targets. When a Lesser Sting reaches 3 stacks of Growth Hormones, it will immediately take action. When a Gnaw Sting or Lesser Sting is defeated, deals 50 Toughness Reduction to Sky-Shrouding Stardevourer Swarm. This Toughness Reduction can ignore the Toughness Protection of Nesting Incubation . When a Lesser Sting is defeated, recovers 1 Skill Point . When Sky-Shrouding Stardevourer Swarm uses Nesting Incubation , its next action Ovum of Collapsed Star is delayed by 25%. Hormone Secretion (Stage 3+): Every 3rd summon spawns with 1 stack of Growth Hormone. The Insect Eggs granted by Nesting Incubation replace those typically granted by Infinite Propagation . Egg Burst (Stage 4): The Insect Eggs granted by Nesting Incubation are increased from 7 to 10 .

gameplayNotes: When Phase 1 starts: The Action of Blaze Out of Space is Advanced Forward by 25%. The Action of Soulhook Sovereign is Delayed by 50%. The Action of Ice Out of Space is Delayed by 25%. When Phase 2 starts: The Action of Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked is Advanced Forward by 100%. The Action of Memory Zone Meme "Shell of Faded Rage" is Advanced Forward by 25%. Soulcaller summons an Blaze Out of Space and Ice Out of Space in phase 1, and a Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked and Memory Zone Meme "Shell of Faded Rage" for phase 2. These enemies are nearly identical to their bug-type variants despite being normal elite enemies. When summoned, Soulhook Sovereign will transfer her weaknesses to them. When all summons are killed, their weaknesses transfer back to the boss. The enemy to her right (Blaze Out of Space and Beyond Overcooked) will always inherit Imaginary and Physical weakness, while the enemy to her left (Ice Out of Space and Shell of Faded Rage) will always inherit Fire and Wind weaknesses. Soulhook Sovereign does not make any Extra Action per turn. Blaze Out of Space and Ice Out of Space with Madden make one additional Extra Action per turn. Beyond Overcooked and Shell of Faded Rage do not make any Extra Action per turn. Soulhook Sovereign loses 25% of her Max Toughness when her summons are defeated. Stellar Aegis (Stage 3+): Each of the boss's summons on the field reduces the damage all enemies take by 75% each. Turn Back the Tide (Stage 4): During Phase 2, Puppet Understudy will enhance both of her summons rather than just one.

When consuming Combusted Skill Points, targets lose HP ( consumes HP equal to 160% of Sam's ATK ) and additionally deal a set amount of Fire DMG equal to a certain percentage ( 30% ) of the original DMG. When they receive healing from sources other than oneself, the amount of HP restored is massively reduced ( 90% ).

skills.name: SGE: Molten Engine
skills.description: While in Secondary Combustion, Sam possesses Molten Energy ( 5 ). When Sam is attacked and the attack consumes Skill Points, a corresponding amount of Molten Energy is reduced. When Molten Energy is depleted or when the Weakness is Broken, dispels Secondary Combustion. When Secondary Combustion is dispelled, Sam receives increased DMG ( 50% ), and recovers all Skill Points for the targets.

gameplayNotes: Sam has Toughness Protection outside of Secondary Combustion. Sam takes 1 action each time outside of Secondary Combustion, and takes 2 consecutive actions each time while in Secondary Combustion . When characters consume Skill Points while Sam is Secondary Combustion , if the character's current HP is not sufficient, then the character's HP is reduced to 1. When characters consume Skill Points to attack while Sam is Secondary Combustion , the Additional DMG dealt by characters scales with the attack's original DMG, and does not take other Additional DMG or DoT Trigger into account.
